title: Book Three · Chapter 40: The Fourth Lap
story:
“Third lap,” Kai tells Ronan.

He points across the track. Anna is beyond the far turn. Several girls are ahead of her. Two more are behind.

Her friend stands beside the bench with Anna's bottle. She has finished her own shorter race.

“How is she?” Ronan asks.

“Steady. She started slowly.”

Ronan puts his bottle on the ground. The ride has left him warm, but he keeps his coat over one arm.

Anna comes nearer. Her face is red. Her arms move close to her sides.

“Anna!” he calls.

She looks toward the sound. For one short moment, she sees him. Then her eyes go back to the track.

She passes the line and begins the fourth lap.

Ronan watches her go round the first turn. There is no sudden rush. She keeps the same short steps.

At the far side, one girl moves ahead of her. Anna does not follow.

“Good,” her friend says quietly.

Ronan takes a step toward the edge of the track. Her friend reaches for his sleeve.

“Stay back. They need that space.”

He looks down. His shoe is near the white line. He steps onto the grass again and moves his bottle farther back.

Another runner passes close to them. Ronan can hear her breath. He lifts his eyes toward Anna at the far side.

From the grass, he can still see her. He stays beside the bench.

Ronan holds his coat tightly. He wants the last turn to be closer. Across the field, the distance still looks long.

The first girls finish. A teacher calls their names and waves them toward the grass. Another girl crosses the line soon after them.

Anna is still at the far turn.

Her friend puts the bottle down and cups her hands around her mouth.

“Keep going!”

Kai calls too. Ronan waits until Anna comes near enough to hear him.

“All the way, Anna!”

She runs past the last white mark. Her steps grow shorter, but she does not stop.

At the line, a teacher lifts one hand.

“Finished. Keep walking.”

Anna slows to a walk. Her friend goes beside her and holds out the bottle. Ronan follows a few steps behind.

For a little while, Anna only walks and breathes. Then she turns her head.

“Four.”

Her friend nods. “All four.”

Anna looks back toward the line. Another runner is still coming in. She lifts her hand and calls to the girl.

Anna's smile comes slowly. She takes a drink and gives the bottle back.

“I nearly went after that girl.”

“You didn't,” her friend says.

Kai leaves to find his other friend. Ronan walks beside Anna near the edge of the grass.

“I missed the first two,” he says.

“I saw you later.”

“I'm sorry about the start.”

She looks ahead for a moment.

“I looked once. Then I had to watch the track.”

He nods. She takes another slow breath.

“You brought the loud voice.”

“Only for the end.”

She smiles again. Her friend comes back with the coat.

After they rest, Ronan collects his bike. He pushes it beside the girls toward the gate. Anna is telling her friend about the long last turn.

He listens as the three of them leave the field together.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

ahead of＝在……前面；sudden rush＝突然冲快；cup one's hands＝把双手拢成喇叭状；all the way＝全程、一直到最后。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan到场时Anna跑到第几圈？他看到了哪些部分？
2. Anna是否拿了冠军？她真正完成了什么自己的目标？

## 读句子

**She passes the line and begins the fourth lap.**

拆开看：She / passes the line / and begins the fourth lap.

她／跑过起终点线／开始第四圈。
